topic: Bachche ko khaali pet kitni der? (doctor ki timing)

cap.q: Dadi: "Doctor Madam, pote ka operation hai, kitni der bhookha rakhoon?"
cap.a: Dr Saathi: "Dadi, zyada bhookha rakhna zaroori nahi, timing maaniye!"
cap.f: Lambi bhookh-pyaas bachche ko pareshaan karti hai. Saaf paani aksar ek ghante pehle tak.
cap.f2: Maa ka doodh teen ghante pehle tak. Khaane ka time doctor batayenge, wahi maaniye.

youtube.description:
Dadi ne poocha: "Pote ka operation hai, kitni der bhookha rakhoon?" 🍼
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Dadi, zyada der bhookha rakhna zaroori nahi — doctor ki timing maaniye! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Zaroorat se lambi bhookh-pyaas bachche ko pareshaan karti hai — usse fayda nahi
✅ Saaf paani (clear fluids) aksar operation se 1 ghanta pehle tak diya ja sakta hai — doctor ki ijaazat se
✅ Maa ka doodh aksar 3 ghante pehle tak
✅ Khaana aur doosra doodh kab band karna hai, doctor/hospital batayenge — wahi maaniye, aur kuch kha liya ho toh doctor ko zaroor bataiye

Darr nahi, taiyaari!
